newsitem.title: CHINA: Beijing Orient earns 69m yuan in H1 97.
newsitem.headline: Beijing Orient earns 69m yuan in H1 97.

text.p: Beijing Orient Electronics (Group) Co Ltd chalked up net profits of 68.72 million yuan on turnover of 111.10 million yuan in the first half of 1997, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said on Friday.
The firm's first half 1997 per-share net reached 0.182 yuan, with net assets per share at 2.58 yuan, the exchange said in a notice released after the market closed.
The notice did not give any comparative figures or say if the results were based on international or Chinese accounting standards.
Last week, a senior company official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin the company had booked about 55 million yuan in net earnings for the first six months of 1996.
Trading in the firm's B shares would be suspended on Monday morning for the announcement, and would resume in the afternoon, the exchange statement said.
Beijing Orient, a maker of lamps and television components, listed 115 million hard currency B shares in Shenzhen in June this year.
